title: Outcome-blind Haze4K official-test scene grouping and 100/150 role isolation
rationale: The official ConvIR-B checkpoint was trained on Haze4K train and its aggregate official-test metric was previously reproduced, so train-only local-error prevalence cannot answer whether the same constructs appear on unseen Haze4K scenes. This qualification performs one complete but outcome-blind official-test structure census, freezes a deterministic 100-scene development-screening and 150-scene candidate-confirmation partition, and materializes physically separated role assets. It loads no model or checkpoint and computes no restoration result or metric. The full test is baseline-exposed but remains candidate-unseen for this research route.

scientific_contract.question: Can the Haze4K official test be outcome-blindly grouped into exactly 250 canonical clear scenes with four nested haze variants each and deterministically isolated into 100 development-screening scenes and 150 candidate-confirmation scenes before any present-route model result is inspected?

intervention.reference: complete Haze4K official-test file census with no model, checkpoint, prediction, restoration metric, local-error metric, threshold analysis, or candidate comparison
intervention.matched_budget: all 1,000 official-test haze observations and paired clear targets used only for pairing, decode, dimension, canonical identity, deterministic role assignment, and isolation
fixed_factors: official loader exact-name then first-token same-extension then first-token PNG precedence
canonical scene SHA-256 over clear-image width, height, and decoded RGB bytes
rank by SHA-256 of split salt and canonical scene digest then digest
first 100 ranked scenes development_screening and remaining 150 candidate_confirmation
all four haze variants of each canonical scene remain in one role
development and candidate-confirmation files are hard-linked into disjoint route-owned role directories
only aggregate counts and assignment digests are publishable; per-image role rows remain cloud-only

primary_estimand.metric: proportion of 250 canonical clear scenes assigned to exactly one frozen role with all four haze variants contained and accessible only through the corresponding isolated role asset
primary_estimand.aggregation: deterministic complete official-test census at canonical clear-scene level

controls: exact 1,000 haze and 1,000 clear file counts
complete deterministic loader pairing, decode, and dimension alignment
exactly four paired haze variants per canonical scene
100/150 scene-role disjointness and complete observation coverage
isolated role assets contain 400/600 haze-clear pairs and no cross-role canonical digest
entrypoint imports no model code and asset list contains no checkpoint

uncertainty.method: deterministic census integrity audit; no sampling interval is used and haze variants never increase the independent scene count

gates.estimand: the only delivered scientific asset is the official-test directory under confirmation permission and the entrypoint contains no model or metric path
all 1,000 haze and 1,000 clear files are paired, decoded, and dimension aligned
exactly 250 canonical scenes have exactly four paired haze observations each
100 development and 150 candidate-confirmation scenes are disjoint and cover all 1,000 observations
route-owned development and candidate-confirmation directories contain only their assigned 400 and 600 exact-name haze-clear pairs with assignment metadata

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Decoded RGB identity validates the frozen leakage-control rule but does not establish original capture provenance or physical filename-token semantics; the four clear aliases may be packaging duplicates. The full official test is baseline-exposed because the official checkpoint aggregate metric was reproduced, so only candidate outcomes—not baseline exposure—remain unseen.
disabled_actions: model construction, checkpoint loading, training, inference, or prediction access
PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, color, local-error, overshoot, undershoot, oracle, proxy, threshold, or candidate computation
visual inspection or per-image failure interpretation
using the 150 candidate-confirmation scenes for the authorized development replication
publishing per-image role assignments, images, arrays, or decoded pixel data
treating haze variants or clear aliases as independent scenes
allowing old Haze4K route outcomes to select this split or its thresholds
NH-HAZE or any other dataset access

precision_contract.rationale: The operation observes all 250 canonical official-test scenes and all 1,000 nested haze observations; structural gates use exact census counts.

precision.source_reference: Worst-case Bernoulli standard deviation 0.5 fixed analytically; the operation observes all 250 canonical official-test scenes.
